sentences.text: Saamy is a 2003 Indian Tamil action film written and directed by Hari .	Hari	Hari (director)	Tamil	Tamil language	action film	action film

presented by K. Balachander and produced by Pushpa Kandasamy under banner Kavithalayaa Productions .	K. Balachander	K. Balachander	Pushpa Kandasamy	Kavithalaya Productions	Kavithalayaa Productions	Kavithalayaa Productions
The film stars Vikram , Trisha and Kota Srinivasa Rao in the lead .	Vikram	Vikram (actor)	Trisha	Trisha Krishnan	Kota Srinivasa Rao	Kota Srinivasa Rao
music was composed by Harris Jayaraj .	Harris Jayaraj	Harris Jayaraj
Upon release , the film was highly successful at the box office .

It was remade in Telugu as Lakshmi Narasimha -LRB- 2004 -RRB- starring Nandamuri Balakrishna and Asin , in Bengali as Barood starring Mithun Chakraborty , in Kannada as Ayya -LRB- 2005 -RRB- starring Darshan and Rakshitha and later in Hindi as Policegiri -LRB- 2013 -RRB- starring Sanjay Dutt and Prachi Desai .
